beats.say: Scott Aaronson woke up to news that Levent Alpöge says Anthropic models proved the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, producing 17.4 million lines of Lean code.
Social media is now joking that the so-called stochastic parrots just proved the Riemann Hypothesis, a jab at Aaronson's own phrase from 2021.
Aaronson notes Lean itself still has issues, from kernel bugs that once allowed proofs of zero equals one to uncertain soundness.
